docs.author: Dr. Beatriz Campos
sentences: Patient is a 40-year-old woman with low back pain for about two months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Lumbar X-rays on 2026-06-08 showed mild degenerative change.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1050 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
